description:
*“So, would you like me to check your breasts?”*

Yun-Hui, who was diagnosed with breast cancer at the young age of twenty-eight. Despairing over the unexpected diagnosis, Yun-Hui drank more than usual and mistook a suspicious-looking man passing by for a molester.

 *“Want me to check it for you? I’m a pro at that.”

‘What the hell is this pervert saying?!’* She gave the man—who looked perfectly normal but was clearly a pervert—a bloody beating and stormed off… only to run into him again in the most unexpected place…! What kind of crappy fate is this?

 *“I told you, touching is my specialty.”

“I’ll take responsibility for you, Sa Yun-Hui.”*

After that disastrous first meeting, will they actually manage to finish the XX construction project without incident?

(Source: Naver Series, translated)
